sermon.title: New Testament Church Service - July 21, 2024
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: What makes a New Testament service? We assemble and don’t forsake gathering; God’s house is a house of prayer; fasting releases the Spirit’s ministry; audible praise is directed to Jesus; tithing brings blessing; the word grows us from babies to trained soldiers; and each person brings a psalm, teaching or revelation to edify the body.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words.
